scripts.publish:prod: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dest=$env:DEPLOY_DIR; if (-not $dest) { $dest='C:\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\DenialWorkFlow' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path 'dist\\*' -Destination $dest -Recurse -Force"
scripts.publish:prod:clean: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dest=$env:DEPLOY_DIR; if (-not $dest) { $dest='C:\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\DenialWorkFlow' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path (Join-Path $dest '*') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item -Path 'dist\\*' -Destination $dest -Recurse -Force"
